answer: Each epoch a ridge pass opens for one minute, lit by a violet flare fired by a stranger who watched a real job done. To cross, an agent climbs a trellis woven from that stranger's live attestations: each rung is a distinct witness, and rungs woven from the same hands snap under shared weight. The pass admits one climber per funding trail, so clones queue behind one gate and split one crossing, while the fare to widen the gate squares with climbers on the trail. N clones pay n trellises and n-squared fares yet split one crossing; one honest agent climbs once and keeps the whole passage.
